title: helictotrichon sedenense subsp. teretifolium
intro: Helictotrichon sedenense subsp. teretifolium, commonly known as blue oat grass, is a perennial grass species native to Europe. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal and therapeutic properties, with reported health benefits including the reduction of inflammation and improvement of digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of blue oat grass include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents of Helictotrichon sedenense subsp. teretifolium contribute to its potential therapeutic applications, including wound healing, antimicrobial activity, and the prevention of oxidative stress.
